case.title: Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo, No. 22-451 (slip opinion)
case.author: Supreme Court of the United States
case.provenance: Slip opinion decided June 28, 2024 (603 U.S. 369), linked from the Court's October Term 2023 opinions page. Slip PDFs can be reissued under a new filename suffix, so bytes are pinned.
case.rightsBasis: Judicial opinion by federal officers (17 U.S.C. 105) and uncopyrightable under the government edicts doctrine (Georgia v. Public.Resource.Org, 2020). The Court's site carries no explicit rights statement. Not relicensed under MIT.

rightsClearance.scope: Statutory and doctrinal basis only; no publisher rights statement, owner confirmation or shipped-catalog admission.

case.reviewStatus: Converted with EPUBCheck, progress and 128 MiB Mac RSS gate. Contract protects footnote text and markers, including the page 97-98 continuation, in source order. Footnote structure (#40) and citation-line paragraphing (#39) are unqualified.
